subject: design/skill-command-prefix-v1
statement: FR-4 is enforced by a **conformance test** in the scripts-test harness, reached by CI via a Go test wrapper in the payload package (same pattern as help purity) — **not** a docgate check. The test is absent until the closing PR (UB-2); once present it fails closed if any skills-tree directory basename or frontmatter `name:` violates `pyxis-*`, and fails if the closing precondition still sees an unprefixed skill (UB-3). (design-brainstorm:skill-command-prefix-tech-design#D-1; G-1 resolved here)
